entities.name: Eulalia de Abaitua y Allende-Salazar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eulalia de Abaitua y Allende-Salazar or Eulalia Abaitua lived in Barcelona, Liverpool and London before becoming an early Spanish photographer based in the Basque port of Bilbao. Her work is now a resource of early Basque culture.
